'''Noors''' were graceful, subterranean [[Species/Legends|animals]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] which were only rarely spotted. Many [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|females]] were named for the species.
